topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class and frames the lecture's focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate Immune Recognition: PAMPs, DAMPs, and Pattern Recognition Receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular basis by which the innate immune system senses microbial products and cellular damage through various pattern recognition receptors and their signaling pathways.

topics.label: Inflammatory Cascade, Leukocyte Recruitment, and Systemic Manifestations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics follow the immediate consequences of innate recognition, covering sentinel cell mediator release, leukocyte recruitment into tissues, lymphatic priming, and systemic hyperinflammation.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Pathology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss how inflammation is resolved through active and passive mechanisms, how tissue repair is mediated, and the causes and adaptations associated with persistent chronic inflammation.

topics.label: Lecture Closing
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and previews the topic of the next lecture.
